Settings

Display
Lexend OFL · headings, light weights
Text
Source Sans 3 OFL
Moves
type-only hero, no giant size, hierarchy by colour, airy setting
Mood
calm, reassuring, clear, kind
Case
Sentence case only; no capitals labels in health copy (they read as alarms).
Numerals and features
font-variant-numeric: lining-nums proportional-nums

09:30 · 2 tablets · room 209:30 · 2 tablets · room 2

Times and doses in lining figures inside sentences; never a dose as a giant number.
Signature
Two lines at the same light 44 px: the first in ink, the second in a deep green tone. Hierarchy by tone, not by size; nothing on the screen is louder than a calm sentence.
Use when
Clinics, pharmacies, therapy and wellbeing apps, appointment and results screens, patient letters.
Turns into slop when
When the second tone is a pale grey (faded text), when stock smiling-doctor photos are added, or when a pastel gradient blob sits behind the text.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
